fusions.name: Gleaning Flurry
fusions.desc: Pecks all around you in a ring, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving each [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on them spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Pick Clean
fusions.desc: Strips one of your afflictions off the target with a peck that deals 8 damage and leaves it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Crop Full
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Scavenger Frenzy
fusions.desc: Every time you kill an enemy, a stack builds on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
